title: A comparative investigation of the mannose binding interface in DC-SIGN and MRC1 carbohydrate recognition domains with all-atom molecular dynamics simulations
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子MD模拟比较DC-SIGN与MRC1甘露糖识别域的蛋白-糖结合界面，虽非TF-DNA体系，但属蛋白-配体互作建模，方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Protein-carbohydrate interactions play a key role in numerous biological processes, including immune response, and glycan-based ligands that can target specific protein receptors on a cell surface represent promising candidates for therapeutics applications. For example, in retinoblastoma, the DC-SIGN mannose receptor (MR) is overexpressed on the surface of pathogenic cell and represents an interesting target for mannose-based ligands. At the same time, these ligands should not bind the MRC1 receptor, which is expressed by adjacent, healthy, retinal pigment epithelial cells. Therefore, the challenge remains to obtain a detailed picture of the recognition process between carbohydrates and proteins, in order to design effective and selective therapeutic compounds. In this work we used classical, all-atom Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations to investigate the interaction between several mannose based ligands and the CRDs from DC-SIGN and MRC1. The analysis of the protein-carbohydrate contacts from the resulting trajectory highlights the variability of the mannose binding modes on both CRDs, and shows how the increased affinity of mannose for the MRC1 CRD can be related to a specific mannose binding state that is not accessible in the DC-SIGN CRD.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质-碳水化合物相互作用在众多生物过程中扮演关键角色，包括免疫反应，而基于聚糖的配体能够靶向细胞表面的特定蛋白质受体，代表了治疗应用中的有前景候选物。例如，在视网膜母细胞瘤中，DC-SIGN甘露糖受体（MR）在致病细胞表面过表达，并代表了基于甘露糖配体的有趣靶点。同时，这些配体不应结合MRC1受体，该受体由邻近的健康视网膜色素上皮细胞表达。因此，挑战仍在于获得碳水化合物与蛋白质之间识别过程的详细图景，以设计有效且选择性的治疗化合物。在本工作中，我们使用经典的全原子分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟来研究几种基于甘露糖的配体与DC-SIGN和MRC1的CRDs之间的相互作用。对所得轨迹中蛋白质-碳水化合物接触的分析突显了甘露糖在两种CRDs上结合模式的变异性，并展示了甘露糖对MRC1 CRD的增强亲和力如何与在DC-SIGN CRD中不可及的特定甘露糖结合状态相关联。
